members.name: BytesIO
members.doc: Buffered I/O implementation using an in-memory bytes buffer.

members.name: dump
members.doc: Write 'value' to a .plist file. 'fp' should be a writable, binary file object.

members.name: dumps
members.doc: Return a bytes object with the contents for a .plist file.

members.name: load
members.doc: Read a .plist file. 'fp' should be a readable and binary file object. Return the unpacked root object (which usually is a dictionary).

members.name: loads
members.doc: Read a .plist file from a bytes object. Return the unpacked root object (which usually is a dictionary).

members.name: ParserCreate
members.doc: Return a new XML parser object.

members.name: PlistFormat
members.doc: Create a collection of name/value pairs. Example enumeration: >>> class Color(Enum): ... RED = 1 ... BLUE = 2 ... GREEN = 3 Access them by: - attribute access:
